name: QA 2113
description:
PCP QA Test No. 2113



Exercise the error paths in the derived metrics parser.



Checks the diagnostics, and checks that a parse which fails does not

leave state behind that corrupts the next expression parsed in the same

process ... specmeta, specflags and in_matchinst are file-scope statics

in derive_parser.y.in that the productions only clear on their success

paths.



Companion test qa/2114 checks the same expressions for memory leaks.
